editorialIntro.heading: On Her Own Time
editorialIntro.paragraph: Imagine Mirella waiting in the dim corners of a late-night lounge while you finish your last call. Her long chestnut hair spills in waves, and she rubs her magenta-pink nails against the edge of the wooden seat. When you finally set down your phone and face her, she offers a slow, knowing smile that suggests she has a far more interesting agenda for the evening. The dark silver-tone pendant at her neck catches a flicker of light as she leans in to ask where the mood takes you next. If you think you can actually keep her on schedule, she is happy to prove you wrong.
